AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Servant child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born into a family of servants. Unlike other ordinary children, [PAWN_nameDef] was taught from an early age to dedicate [PAWN_objective]self to [PAWN_possessive] master, and has been learning how to serve them.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Noble child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s grandparents had performed notable feats for the Oberonia Aurea Empire, and thus received the status of nobility. This allowed [PAWN_nameDef] to spend a childhood that was more leisurely and cozy than that of usual children.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Successor
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born into a high noble family in Oberonia Aurea. As a possible future heir to the title, [PAWN_nameDef] has been receiving an all-encompassing education since [PAWN_pronoun] can remember, in order to fulfill [PAWN_possessive] duties as a nobleman in the future.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Children adopted by the court
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s parents passed away early due to an accident. The local court eventually stepped in to adopt the still young [PAWN_nameDef] out of humane considerations, and raised [PAWN_pronoun] as a future full member of the family.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Palace Children
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Both of [PAWN_nameDef]'s parents were members of the court. Because of their positions, [PAWN_nameDef] was often brought into the court at a young age and was taught by [PAWN_possessive] parents.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Observant Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was always curious about everything around [PAWN_objective] in [PAWN_possessive] childhood, which gave [PAWN_pronoun] a unique perspective on the natural environment around and how people interact with each other.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Little Chef
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is interested in everything that can be cooked, so [PAWN_pronoun] is always trying to throw whatever [PAWN_pronoun] can manage into the pot.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Little Artist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has an innate sense of beauty, and [PAWN_pronoun] always produces some fine patterns.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Trouble-maker
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] often engaged in mind-numbing behaviors during [PAWN_possessive] childhood, which caused [PAWN_possessive] parents to worry a lot about [PAWN_pronoun].

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Thinker
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef], like most Oberonia Aurea children, was quiet and unruffled as a child. Slightly more concerning, though, is that [PAWN_nameDef] seems to be too quiet.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Decryptor
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] doesn't like the feeling of the unknown. When [PAWN_pronoun] was very young, [PAWN_nameDef] was determined to find the answers to all questions.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Sandlot Buster
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: In the playground for children, [PAWN_nameDef] loves the sandbox where [PAWN_pronoun] can freely use [PAWN_possessive] creativity. Sometimes [PAWN_nameDef] even fights with other children to monopolize the sandbox.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·little explorer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s childhood was spent in a book of adventure stories. Whether it was the history of the Oberonia Aurea Ratkins exploring their home planet over the Great Basin in the snowstorm, or the legendary experiences of the first Oberonia Aurea Ratkins to set foot on an alien planet, all of these fascinated [PAWN_nameDef] and encouraged [PAWN_pronoun] to embark on [PAWN_possessive] own adventures in the future, just like the characters in the books.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Children who follow the rules
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a very obedient child, whenever [PAWN_possessive] parents tell [PAWN_objective] to, then [PAWN_pronoun] tries to do [PAWN_possessive] best.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Children in the Physician's Home
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s mother was a physician at the court, and by ear, [PAWN_pronoun] learned some basic medical skills.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·OA-Communicative Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] childhood socializing one after another. Even [PAWN_possessive] parents didn't know why [PAWN_nameDef] always had endless things to say.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Carefree Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] doesn't know what worrying is or repair the house before it rains. [PAWN_pronoun] was more interested in knowing what to eat tonight than esoteric stuffs.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Friend of Animals
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Whenever the group went out, [PAWN_nameDef] was always the one who stood out the most, and even [PAWN_nameDef] [PAWN_objective]self couldn't explain why [PAWN_pronoun] always attracted critters.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Streetwalker Kids
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] enjoys wandering around, whether it's a deserted alley or a crowded main street, [PAWN_pronoun] can always be found.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Child with potted plants
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] enjoys keeping potted plants, and [PAWN_pronoun] will always carefully summarize the experiences learned from each time [PAWN_pronoun] takes care of a plant and then use it on the next one.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Stubborn Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has a defiant spirit, and when people say [PAWN_pronoun] can't do something, [PAWN_pronoun] will always practice hard to prove it to others.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Eldest child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is the oldest child in the family, so sometimes [PAWN_pronoun] tends to have to take care of his younger siblings on his own when his parents aren't home.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Child of Metropolis
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a thriving metropolis. Even looking at [PAWN_possessive] entire childhood, [PAWN_pronoun] had only a handful of encounters with animals.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Child in hospital beds
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Even the highly technologically advanced Oberonia Aurea Empire, difficult diseases still exists, and unfortunately [PAWN_nameDef] was one of the victims of these diseases. Even though [PAWN_nameDef] managed to heal later on, it still left behind some hidden sequelae.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Scared Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was once chased by a large dog when [PAWN_pronoun] was a child, and even though the palace guards at the time were able to subdue the rabid dog in time, the incident still left a mental shadow over [PAWN_nameDef], which is so serious so that [PAWN_pronoun] was always tempted to avoid animals.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Stargazing Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] always longed for the mystery of the universe. In [PAWN_possessive] childhood, [PAWN_pronoun] would always sit alone under the starry sky, looking at the vast stars and thinking about aliens.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Children of Artistic Families
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in an artistic family, and [PAWN_possessive] parents were always making [PAWN_pronoun] learn about art, whether [PAWN_nameDef] wanted to or not.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Child in Remote Areas
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up on a colony planet on the edge of the Empire, where there wasn't much prosperity, and so [PAWN_pronoun] grew to learn how to live with nature.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Cautious Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was brought to the galaxy by [PAWN_possessive] parents as a child. In this volatile colony, the one thing [PAWN_nameDef] was told most was that [PAWN_pronoun] must learn how to protect [PAWN_objective]self.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Costume Design Apprentice
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] loved those beautiful clothes, so when [PAWN_pronoun] was a child, [PAWN_pronoun] volunteered to work for a costume designer as a costume design apprentice.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Hands-On Kid
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: What's this? Take it apart and look at it. What's this? Take it apart again. Accompanied by the sound of falling mechanical parts and the exclamations of [PAWN_possessive] parents, [PAWN_nameDef]'s childhood was spent in curiosity and hands-on experience over and over again.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Favored Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has always cared about how [PAWN_pronoun] dresses, so much so that she prepares herself meticulously before every outing. Few people would meet [PAWN_nameDef] for the first time and not be impressed.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Kind Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: It is difficult for [PAWN_nameDef] to be indifferent to the suffering of others. As long as someone turns to [PAWN_nameDef] for help, then [PAWN_pronoun] will be sure to help them as much as possible.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Child Who Travels a Lot
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: At a very young age, [PAWN_nameDef] traveled between stars with [PAWN_possessive] parents. This experience greatly broadened [PAWN_possessive] horizons and honed [PAWN_possessive] abilities.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Street Sculptor
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] loves to polish a block of stone into an exquisite sculpture. When [PAWN_pronoun] sculpts in the streets, it always makes passerby stop.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Street Painter
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a street painter. Wherever [PAWN_pronoun] goes, [PAWN_pronoun] wears a small drawing pad to facilitate improvisation when inspiration strikes.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Street Painter
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a street painter. Wherever [PAWN_pronoun] goes, [PAWN_pronoun] wears a small drawing pad to facilitate improvisation when inspiration strikes.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Creative Technician
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is quite accomplished in art, so the local court recruited [PAWN_objective] as a court painter so that [PAWN_pronoun] could freely create art without interference.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Evangelist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: For [PAWN_nameDef], creation itself is not pleasurable, but teaching others how to do it is. Therefore, most of the time, [PAWN_nameDef] is always teaching others how to express themselves emotionally.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Sociology Enthusiast
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] likes to study the changing course of society. [PAWN_pronoun] always conducts social experiments, sometimes even using [PAWN_objective]self as part of the experiment.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Citizen who Keep a Diary
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] prefers to trust physically existing information over trusting [PAWN_possessive] own memory, so [PAWN_pronoun] has been keeping a diary of every day of [PAWN_possessive] life.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Citizen Who Love Outings
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] doesn't like to be in crowded places all the time, so whenever [PAWN_pronoun] has enough free time, [PAWN_pronoun] often chooses to take a short trip outside of town.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Piano Player
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is accomplished at the piano, and [PAWN_pronoun] prefers to mix [PAWN_possessive] emotions into music than communicate verbally.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Great Pianist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is undoubtedly an exceptional performer. Whether it's an impassioned epic or a tender serenade, [PAWN_possessive] keys are perfectly interpreted and reach the listener's heart.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Meticulous Servant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] doesn't like coping with work. For [PAWN_objective], things like work are either not to do it, or when they are done, they are done perfectly.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Enthusiastic Citizen
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is an uncompromisingly good old buddy in the eyes of those around [PAWN_objective]. Whenever others encounter any difficulties, [PAWN_nameDef] is always happy to lend a helping hand.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Conservative Citizen
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Unlike most citizens of Oberonia Aurea, [PAWN_nameDef] preferred to brew a cup of floral tea alone while others wondered about the existence of aliens, then sit at home and watch people come and go outside [PAWN_possessive] window. For [PAWN_nameDef], the wonders of the stars are far less beautiful than those around [PAWN_objective].

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Star Trekker
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Long before the Oberonia Aurea Empire entered the galaxy, [PAWN_nameDef] had been traveling through stars for a long time. To [PAWN_objective], the galaxy was also just a place to travel.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Culinary Artist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s cooking was quite famous throughout the colony, and no one could say no to the delicacies cooked by [PAWN_pronoun]

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Cowardly Citizen
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Growing up in a peaceful environment, [PAWN_nameDef] was completely unable to adapt to chaos. Therefore, when [PAWN_pronoun] learned about the tragic experiences of the first batch of compatriots who entered the galaxy, [PAWN_nameDef] had a lingering shadow over the galaxy.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Edle Artists
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Like most low-level nobles, [PAWN_nameDef] often wandered between opera houses and art galleries. But unlike most of those who come to enjoy them, [PAWN_nameDef] is more interested in learning and borrowing, then perfecting [PAWN_possessive] own artistry.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Low-Level Edle
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Despite having the status of a noble, [PAWN_nameDef] did not let it stop [PAWN_objective]self from being a self-made guy. On the contrary, [PAWN_nameDef] still learns the basics of crafting and artistry just like any other citizen in order to contribute to the prosperity of the Oberonia Aurea Empire.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Scattered Elde
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: While the nobles of the Oberonia Aurea had nothing to do most of the time, [PAWN_nameDef] was clearly scatterbrained to the point of being an outlier. [PAWN_nameDef] spends most of [PAWN_possessive] time having fun and socializing, to the point where [PAWN_pronoun] can't even make the most basic crafts.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Ambitious Elde
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Unlike the descendants of other low-level nobles who rested on their laurels, [PAWN_nameDef] was never the one to be easily satisfied. So [PAWN_pronoun] took the initiative to come to the galaxy, hoping to earn new feats here.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Freiherr
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Although still a low-level noble, the status of a Freiherr is enough for [PAWN_nameDef] to enjoy some of the privileges of nobility, and correspondingly, [PAWN_nameDef] needs to take respond to some of the local affairs, as well as assisting the local court.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Vizegraf
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Although it wasn't enough to spend the whole day running around for political affairs, [PAWN_nameDef] most of the time was spent in the court. In the noble system of Oberonia Aurea, the status of a Vizegraf was no longer a right, but more of a duty.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Markgraf
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: The Markgraf's status among the Oberonia Aurea requires [PAWN_possessive] to take on the responsibility of ruling the local area, and thus [PAWN_nameDef]'s life, even with the care of [PAWN_possessive] attendants, is still quite stressful, which makes it necessary for [PAWN_pronoun] to spend almost every day in total concentration.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·External Hochadel
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: The bloodline brought not only honor, but also a duty, and [PAWN_nameDef] knew this truth profoundly. So even though the galaxy was rife with the risk of instability, [PAWN_pronoun] still fulfilled the order to travel to the galaxy and assist in the vast political affairs of the new colony.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Inner Hochadel
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Whether it is the special education at an early age or the influence of the family's heritage, [PAWN_nameDef] is being instilled with a mission —— as the constituents and executors of the highest consciousness of the Oberonia Aurea, no matter what others may think of it, but the Inner Hochadel must dedicate their lives to the Oberonia Aurea. [PAWN_nameDef] has always done so in the past, and [PAWN_pronoun] will continue to do so in the future.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Court Attendant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: The functioning of the court requires a large number of attendants to maintain it, and [PAWN_nameDef] is a member of the attendants. As a attendant, [PAWN_nameDef] knows how to handle both the life of serving nobles and the chores within the palace.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Court Field Staff
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: As a member of the palace's field staff, [PAWN_nameDef] spends most of [PAWN_possessive] time patrolling the neighborhoods to deal with emergencies——whether it's first aid or emergency repairs to equipment, [PAWN_nameDef] has received training exercises on these subjects.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Squire Attendant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description:
The high-level nobles of the Oberonia Aurea will sometimes sign a service contract with their loyal and capable attendants, and these attendants who have voluntarily signed the contract are known as squires. 

Compared to ordinary attendants, squires serve their masters, and the masters often trust them unconditionally. 

[PAWN_nameDef] is one of the clan members of the squire families, and [PAWN_pronoun] has been instilled with the idea of loyalty to the master's family since [PAWN_pronoun] was born. In [PAWN_nameDef]'s eyes, serving one's master was a matter of course.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Squire Elite
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description:
The high-level nobles of the Oberonia Aurea will sometimes sign a service contract with their loyal and capable attendants, and these attendants who have voluntarily signed the contract are known as squires. 

Compared to ordinary attendants, squires serve their masters, and the masters often trust them unconditionally. 

[PAWN_nameDef] is one of the best amongst the squires, and [PAWN_nameDef] is always able to help the master when he or she encounters a problem.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA· Loose Attendant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Although the vast majority of court attendants were hardworking and conscientious, there were a few who would be lazy and malfeasant from time to time. [PAWN_nameDef] is a typical example of this kind.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA· Busy Attendant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is always busy. Few people could figure out how [PAWN_pronoun] was able to complete each and every job efficiently and accurately. But everyone knew that if they were to compare work efficiency, [PAWN_nameDef] would definitely be the top of the heap.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Court Tailor
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was responsible for making the garments according to the requirements of the court. Compared to those free designers, [PAWN_nameDef] doesn’t have as many excellent designs, but that didn't stop [PAWN_pronoun] from being an outstanding tailor.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Maintainer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a member of the Maintenance Bureau of the Court Engineering Department. Whether it's nuclear, electrical, mechanical or cutting edge energy, [PAWN_pronoun] knows how to maintain them.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA· Machine Operator
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was responsible for operating those large machines in the Ministry of Industry, a duty that effectively honed [PAWN_nameDef]'s operational skills as well as [PAWN_possessive] logical thinking.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Investigator
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: As a member of the Ministry of Exterior, [PAWN_nameDef] is seldom seen in the court, instead more often than not [PAWN_pronoun] spends [PAWN_possessive] time on the streets chatting with the citizens. The duties of a investigator require [PAWN_nameDef] to be efficient in keeping up to date with the latest demands of the citizens, and to come back to the court in a timely manner.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Squire Secretary
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a member of the Oberonia Aurea government system. Normally [PAWN_nameDef] is required to follow a noble and record his or her words, actions, and governmental orders, and then summarize and implement the recorded matters after handing over the work to the next squire secretary. \n\nOccasionally, when the local nobles can't handle their own affairs, [PAWN_nameDef] tends to get involved in the basic governmental affairs as well.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Hydroponics Operator
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was in charge of the most important part of agricultural production in the Oberonia Aurea Empire. Even though the hydroponics technology of the Oberonia Aurea was already outstanding, [PAWN_nameDef] still needed to keep an eye on the crops and make timely adjustments to the relevant parameters.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Mine Clerk
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] knew how to recognize each ore from the parameters displayed on the electronic screen and separate them from the rock ledge without any damage. It was a task that required talent, at least in [PAWN_nameDef]'s own opinion.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Technical Specialist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: No matter it's mining, or agriculture, [PAWN_nameDef] is able to get the job done with great efficiency. Unfortunately, however, other than these, [PAWN_nameDef]'s knowledge of any other fields is quite poor.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA· Researcher
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: As an empire that had already stepped into the interstellar colonization stage, the Oberonia Aurea Empire deeply understood the importance of technological development. [PAWN_nameDef] is one of the members of the Oberonia Aurea Empire's Ministry of Science, where [PAWN_pronoun] has an absolutely comfortable living environment to ensure that [PAWN_pronoun] can devote [PAWN_objective]self to scientific research.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Omni-Technical Specialist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: If there were some favorites in the Palace's Industrial Department, then [PAWN_nameDef] would definitely be one of those people. As an omni-technical specialist, there is almost no industrial challenge that [PAWN_nameDef] can't handle.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Court Administrator
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Trying to keep the daily routine of a huge palace organized is a difficult task, but not impossible for [PAWN_nameDef] to accomplish. For the vast majority of the time [PAWN_nameDef] spends [PAWN_possessive] time interacting with massive amounts of information, but amazingly [PAWN_pronoun] is still able to handle these matters in an organized manner.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA· Palace Core Attendant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is one of the core attendant of the court. At a time when most people are at a loss for words, [PAWN_pronoun] is often able to give the best solutions.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA· Merchant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was part of the supply chain of the Oberonia Aurea Empire. In order to ensure the flow of supplies, [PAWN_pronoun] would always be traveling from one unfamiliar place to another. For [PAWN_nameDef], both seeing new things and facilitating the circulation of those things were things full of fun.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Instructor
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: As an instructor, [PAWN_nameDef] is responsible for teaching the Oberonia Aurea young children the basics of life and setting an example for them to follow in order to facilitate the successful development of these children.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA· Volunteer Coordinator
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] serves as an intermediary between the court and the people, coordinating relations between the court and the citizens and acting as a liaison between the court and the people when the court needs it. Occasionally, [PAWN_pronoun] also helps the citizens on [PAWN_possessive] own to solve problems when the Court's Exterior Department fails to send someone in a timely manner.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA· Craftsman with Dreams
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] didn't want to live in obscurity all the time, so [PAWN_pronoun] decided to leave [PAWN_possessive] mark on the world through [PAWN_possessive] own hands.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Trusted Attendant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised in the court from a young age, so it was only logical that [PAWN_pronoun] joined the court as an adult and became one of the court's full-fledged attendants.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Farang
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is not satisfied with a stable but unchanging life, so [PAWN_nameDef] takes it upon [PAWN_objective]self to travel to distant and unfamiliar fringe planets and has fun and grows from one adventure to the next.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Extreme-Cold Researcher
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a researcher at the “Absolute Zero” Research Bureau of the Imperial Ministry of Science. In order to discover the mysteries of temperature, [PAWN_pronoun] has traveled back and forth across the galaxy time and time again, and has been injured, but [PAWN_nameDef] believes it is all worth it.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Model Citizen
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is an model citizen who has been honored by the court, which means that both in character and personal ability, [PAWN_nameDef] is one of the best in the city.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Guilty Citizen
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] had once broken the laws of Oberonia Aurea, and was then sentenced to provide unpaid domestic service for several years, and gradually corrected [PAWN_possessive] own original thinking through contact and interaction with moral role models. \n\nBut it's clear that [PAWN_nameDef] doesn't seem to have changed much.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Leisurely Citizen
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a citizen of the Oberonia Aurea Empire, [PAWN_pronoun] most characterized as carefree, as well as unmotivated, compared to most of the Empire citizen.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Failed Merchant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Before coming here, [PAWN_nameDef] had screwed up business a number of times, even though [PAWN_pronoun] was well prepared. Maybe it was just bad luck or something, at least [PAWN_nameDef] hadn't figured it out [PAWN_objective]self. \n\nSo [PAWN_pronoun] came here, prepare to try again.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Costume designer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is one of the costume designers of the Oberonia Aurea Empire, and it is because of the efforts of countless designers like [PAWN_nameDef] that Oberonia Aurea's costumes have grown to the level just like today.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Court Physician
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a physician in the court. On weekdays [PAWN_pronoun] spends most of [PAWN_possessive] time at home, and [PAWN_pronoun] only travels to the court when the court needs [PAWN_objective] or when it is [PAWN_possessive] shift.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Bard
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Not satisfied with the ordinary, not yearning for stability, [PAWN_nameDef] is always looking forward to the unknown journey. [PAWN_pronoun] will write every trip into a poem, and release [PAWN_possessive] feelings freely in the poem.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Traveler
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] preferred a variety of landscapes to [PAWN_possessive] unchanging hometown. So when [PAWN_nameDef] is in search of the next place to travel, [PAWN_pronoun] embarked on a ship to the galaxy and came to the place.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Recorder
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] used to serve as an attendant in the court of the Oberonia Aurea home planet, but now [PAWN_pronoun] has been sent out to the other colonies of Oberonia Aurea to record the local people's livelihoods and court politics, and to publish them on the Oberonia Aurea information network in order to promote communication and understanding between the regions.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Court Chief
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] serves as the supreme head of a court. The position of chief requires [PAWN_nameDef] to be rational at all times, and to possess efficient personnel handling and decision-making skills to make the court run more efficiently.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Decision Maker
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is responsible for scrutinizing the decrees issued by the high command and the royal family, and writing to those who govern if they find something amiss, to ensure that the decrees and laws are realistic and reliable.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Court Designer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: When [PAWN_nameDef] first arrived at the court, [PAWN_pronoun] devoted most of [PAWN_possessive] free time at work to studying the arts and the architecture of the Oberonia Aurea, and as such, [PAWN_pronoun] was later assigned to the Engineering Department, where [PAWN_pronoun] was involved in the design of the Oberonia Aurea buildings and making sure they were safe and elegant.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Citizen who loves to dress up
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Even though most of the Citizens of the Oberonia Aurea Empire are well dressed, [PAWN_nameDef] certainly takes it up a notch from there. Even the Designer of a costume can't always think of something so brilliantly put together and worn.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Trained Attendant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] As one of the reserve members of the Court Guard, [PAWN_pronoun] received the relevant military training, as well as the most basic military education, during [PAWN_possessive] free time on shift.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Armaments Designer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [Once a member of the Court Guard, [PAWN_nameDef] is now in charge of updating and improving the armaments of the Court, and some of the Blitz Squad's equipment is the work of [PAWN_nameDef].

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Court Guard Member
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a member of the Court Guard. According to the shift system, when [PAWN_pronoun]'s batch is over, [PAWN_pronoun] will leave the Court Guard and resume [PAWN_possessive] normal status as a Court Attendant again.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Court Guard Captain
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a Squad Leader in the Court Guard. Unlike other Guard Members, [PAWN_nameDef]'s position as a Squad Leader defines [PAWN_pronoun] as a full-time military personnel. As such [PAWN_nameDef] will be contributing [PAWN_objective]self to the defense of the Empire until [PAWN_pronoun] reaches the end of [PAWN_possessive] years of service.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Skilled Captain
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was once one of the Court Guard Members of the new colony on the Edge, and was involved in many of the Beast's purges. And after the Empire entered the galaxy, [PAWN_nameDef] was mobilized because of the situation and became one of the Court Guard's squad leaders.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Court Gurad Instructor
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef], as one of the first Court Guard Members to embrace the Galactic military philosophy, has rightfully become a military instructor for the Court Guard. Today [PAWN_nameDef] spends most of [PAWN_possessive] time as an instructor, training Guard Members throughout the day within the palace.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Negotiator
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is the court's chosen foreign negotiator for matters related to diplomacy, trade and cooperation between the Oberonia Aurea Empire and local powers.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Assiduous Attendant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] always had an unconquerable will, even when [PAWN_pronoun] was chosen to join the Court Guard, [PAWN_pronoun] was always the one who trained the hardest.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Xenophile Traveler
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] Not as conservative as the traditional Oberonia Aurea Citizen, [PAWN_pronoun] has always looked forward to every encounter with an alien species and has embarked on journeys to alien planets time and time again.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Experienced Traveler
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is an experienced adventurer, and [PAWN_possessive] many alien expeditions have allowed [PAWN_pronoun] to survive for a long time even when [PAWN_pronoun] falls alone in the wilderness. However, because [PAWN_pronoun] hasn't interacted with others most of the time, [PAWN_nameDef]'s social skills have dropped to a very poor level.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Rebellious Traveler
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] couldn't accept Oberonia Aurea's traditional values of harmony and camaraderie, so [PAWN_pronoun] embarked on an adventurous journey alone. After all, as long as one reaches a place where civilization is not involved, then whatever one does there will not be constrained, right?

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Blitz Member with Hate
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: A close friend of [PAWN_nameDef]'s was a member of the first galactic colonization team, and later, when word of what happened to that group of colonists reached [PAWN_nameDef]'s ears, the fury of resentment shattered [PAWN_pronoun]'s sanity. Nowadays, [PAWN_nameDef] wants nothing more than to make the creatures of the galaxy pay.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Blitz Squad Member
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is one of the Blitz Squad's team members. Unlike the Court Guard, [PAWN_nameDef] is a full-time military officer. Unless on a military mission, [PAWN_nameDef] does not appear in the day-to-day activities of the palace.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Realistic Blitz Member
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a Guard Member on a dangerous planet before becoming a member of the Blitz Squad. multiple blood lessons have taught [PAWN_pronoun] that war is not a child's play, and that death can come at any time.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Blitz Squad Goal Breaker
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a member of the Blitz Squad in charge of breaking and entering assaults. Compared to other Blitz Members, [PAWN_nameDef] is better at close-range firefighting.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Reinstall Blitz Squad
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is skilled with heavy weapons, so most of the time [PAWN_pronoun] tends to act as a support hand, tasked with supporting Blitz Squad's offense with heavy firepower from a distance.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Blitz Squad Leader
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s military skills are outstanding, and few people in the entire court are capable of such excellent combat skills. When the Blitz Squad was formed, [PAWN_nameDef] was chosen to be one of the squad leaders of the Blitz Squad.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Blitz Squad Commander
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is not as good at solo combat as other captains, but is more adept at squad command. Therefore on the battlefield [PAWN_nameDef] doesn't rush too far ahead, but mostly commands the battle from a place where [PAWN_pronoun] can have an overview of the whole scene.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Blitz Squad Newcomer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] had only recently joined the Blitz Squad, and [PAWN_pronoun]'s military skills weren't particularly impressive compared to those of the seasoned members.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Poised Blitz Member
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: In the vast majority of situations, [PAWN_nameDef] has been able to keep [PAWN_objective]self calm. When Blitz Squad loses command, [PAWN_pronoun] is often the first to take command.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Optimistic Blitz Member
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was always the most optimistic member of Blitz Squad, and as long as [PAWN_pronoun] was around, then the atmosphere wouldn't be too bad. However, [PAWN_nameDef]'s heartless attitude also made [PAWN_pronoun]'s training results not too favorable.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Able-bodied Member
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: If there was anyone who could keep up with those seasoned pioneers, then [PAWN_nameDef] would definitely be one of them. Even if it was an attack that most people wouldn't be able to react to, [PAWN_pronoun] would be able to easily avoid it.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Blitz SquadMedic
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a medical member of the Blitz Squad and is trained in all aspects of battlefield first aid. On the battlefield [PAWN_nameDef] is responsible for resuscitating the lives of the seriously injured and supporting them until they return to their garrison so that specialized first aid can be administered by professionals within the palace.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Aloof Medic
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a medical member of the Blitz Squad, and [PAWN_pronoun] was already a doctor of some note before coming to the Blitz Squad. Years of experience alongside death have made [PAWN_nameDef] rarely let [PAWN_possessive] emotions rule [PAWN_objective], making [PAWN_pronoun] quite reliable, but also quite difficult to deal with.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Blitz Squad Pioneer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is one of the pioneers of Blitz Squad. As a vanguard, [PAWN_pronoun] has military literacy far beyond the norm, and whenever Blitz Squad is in combat, [PAWN_nameDef] will always be the first one to launch an attack on the enemy.
